decisions.reason: As a product that builds on the firm’s established postpress offer, remained on its own webpage in both 2023 and 2024, and fits the announced move toward automated connected workflows, management would likely continue it and interpret any mixed performance as still improvable rather than grounds for withdrawal.

Because this folding add-on is close to the core portfolio, supports the firm’s modular automation logic, and was still being referenced in 2024 with a concrete customer-use case, management would likely keep it on the market despite any limited traction so far.
